newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba sees higher 1996 operating profit.
newsitem.headline: Ciba sees higher 1996 operating profit.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Ciba-Geigy AG said it was confident about 1996 and further improvements in operating performance should lead to a higher operating profit compared with 1995.
Ciba also said in its interim report that the strong growth trend seen in the second quarter should continue for the full year.
"Further improvements in operating performance are expected with a resulting higher operating profit," Ciba said.

In July Ciba's chief financial officer Rolf Meyer told Reuters that the firm expected the acceleration of sales growth seen in the first half to continue into the third quarter and that the group will post higher 1996 results.
Ciba reported an operating profit of 3,046 million Swiss francs in 1995 and a net profit of 2,156 million.
